name: Seafile
description: Seafile is a powerful open-source file synchronization and sharing platform designed for high reliability, performance, and productivity. It allows users to store and manage files securely, collaborate with team members, and access files from any device. With features like file versioning, encryption, and seamless integration with various tools, Seafile is ideal for both personal and enterprise use.
